blocks.label: Authentication gateway handling user identity verification
blocks.responsibility: Manages user sign-in flow including credential validation and token generation
blocks.trigger_mechanism: Activated when a user submits login credentials via HTTP POST

blocks.label: User management providing account listing capabilities
blocks.responsibility: Handles retrieval and display of registered user accounts
blocks.trigger_mechanism: Activated when a user requests the user list endpoint

blocks.label: Scheduled maintenance performing periodic data cleanup
blocks.responsibility: Removes outdated records and maintains data hygiene on a schedule
blocks.trigger_mechanism: Runs automatically every 24 hours via system scheduler

block_relations.relation: Authentication block provides session context consumed by user management
Maintenance block cleans up stale user records managed by user management
block_relations.inferred_reason: Both modules reference the same user data store based on import analysis
